title: DFU HBOT Burden CKS Version 1.0 normative schemas

display_label.const: General DFU HBOT planning range: approximately 30–40 episodes, usually five per week, over approximately 6–8 weeks.

analysisQuestionnaireResponse.description: Analysis-ingress form of the completed response. Structure and all non-roster identity fields remain exact; provider_roster_version_iri is admitted as an absolute HTTPS IRI so Section 9.2 can deterministically classify cross-artifact compatibility at stage 9.

weekday_attendance_difficulty.description: Subjective ordinal report of anticipated non-travel difficulty attending the scheduled HBOT course at the confirmed location, using the Q04 anchors in Section 4.2.

providerRosterSnapshot.title: Canonical provider-roster snapshot
providerRosterSnapshot.description: The complete, closed, versioned JSON value used as the provider-roster dependency for identification, validation, RFC 8785 canonical-content fingerprinting, audit, and reproducible replay. It is not a source document, working file, database representation, selected record, or formatted JSON file's raw bytes.

roster_version_iri.description: Exact immutable roster-version IRI represented by this snapshot.

record_count.description: Must equal both 141 and the actual records-array length.

record_order.description: Records must occur in ascending compact_id order, E-001 through E-141.

records.description: Every complete roster record exactly once, ordered by ascending compact_id.

message.const: Top-level input must be an object.
Input has an invalid data type.
Unexpected input property is not permitted.
Input artifact identity, status, or version is invalid.
Duplicate property name is not permitted.
Required input must not be null.
Input value is outside the closed value set or constraint.
Required provider roster is unavailable or invalid.

scenarioBurden.description: Presentation-ready scenario values. Shorter-scenario travel, total, and distance use Section 6.3 lower_endpoint serialization; longer-scenario values use upper_endpoint serialization. Facility hours are exact.

sensitivity.description: Presentation-ready difference values. Incremental travel hours, total hours, and miles use Section 6.3 nearest_value half-up serialization; facility hours and weeks are exact.

text.const: General DFU planning regimen range of 30–40 episodes at five sessions per week is used; it was not selected or calculated for the patient.

A single fixed three-hour scheduled facility block per treatment episode is used as a conservative, realistic worst-case planning assumption. It is not a validated DFU-specific door-to-door elapsed-time estimate.
Round trip is estimated as two times the patient-reported usual one-way miles and minutes.
Reported travel values are planning estimates and are not independently verified by the engine.
